method: USDA-NRCS published dominant-component response rating on the native 30 m equal-area soil grid. County assignment uses cell centers. State totals sum county cells. All mapped land uses. Soil ratings estimate response potential.
source: Native FY2026 USDA-NRCS 30 m gSSURGO map-unit grid. Only retired map-unit IDs are refreshed from current USDA polygons at native cell centers.
